# fortiappseccloud_waf_file_protection

Configures file protection for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/file_protection`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_file_protection` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_file_protection`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_file_protection" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status            = true
    action            = "alert_deny"
    trojan            = false
    sandbox           = false
    av_scan           = true
    file_action       = "Allow"
    file_size         = 10240
    url               = "/1"
    json_file_support = false

    file_types {
      item {
        type = "GIF"
        tid  = "00001"
      }
    }

    custom_file_types {
      item {
        name           = "custom-archive"
        file_extension = "foo"

        file_content_match_rule {
          item {
            data_value       = "magic-bytes"
            offset_from      = "beginning"
            offset           = 0
            operation        = "equal"
            data_type        = "string"
            concatenate_type = "AND"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- When `json_file_support = true`, also set `json_key_field`. Each file type needs a compatible `type` and five-digit `tid`; hexadecimal content values must contain valid, even-length hexadecimal data.

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Action. One of `alert`, `alert_deny`, `deny_no_log`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `av_scan` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Av scan for file protection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `file_action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets File action. One of `Allow`, `Block`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `file_size` (Optional, Computed) — Sets File size. Between 0 and 102400. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `json_file_support` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Json file support for file protection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `json_key_field` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Json key field. At most 63 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `json_key_for_filename` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Json key for filename. At most 63 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `sandbox` (Optional, Computed) — Controls Sandbox for file protection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables file protection. Omission preserves the current value.

## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_file_protection.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
